questions.prompt: A new PC cannot find the DC when joining a domain. What should be checked first?
options: A. Internal DNS and network access
B. Wallpaper
C. PST file size
D. USB port name
questions.answer: A. Internal DNS and network access
questions.explanation:
Internal DNS and network access

Domain clients discover DC services through DNS, so internal DNS matters.

questions.prompt: An employee changes departments and no longer needs the old project. What should be done?
options: A. Remove unneeded group access
B. Add the account to every group
C. Put the password in a ticket
D. Disable MFA permanently
questions.explanation:
Remove unneeded group access

Least privilege requires reviewing access when a person changes roles.

questions.prompt: You suspect a GPO did not apply. Which command shows resultant policy?
options: A. `gpresult /r`
B. `ipconfig /release`
C. `format c:`
D. `netstat -ano`
questions.explanation:
`gpresult /r`

`gpresult /r` summarizes policies applied to the user and computer.

questions.prompt: A user receives an unexpected MFA approval prompt. What is the safe response?
options: A. Deny it and report to IT/security
B. Approve it and share the password
C. Disable MFA
D. Forward it to a friend
questions.answer: A. Deny it and report to IT/security
questions.explanation:
Deny it and report to IT/security

An unexpected MFA prompt may signal account risk; do not approve it.

questions.prompt: OST will not sync; the user also wants to delete the PST. What is the best first step?
options: A. Close Outlook and check connectivity/quota; do not delete without backup/approval
B. Delete all OST and PST files
C. Treat PST as the server mailbox
D. Email the file to a personal account
questions.answer: A. Close Outlook and check connectivity/quota; do not delete without backup/approval
questions.explanation:
Close Outlook and check connectivity/quota; do not delete without backup/approval

OST is a cache and PST an export/archive; backup and authorization are needed before deletion.
